integrity.note: A non-empty tracked_but_missing_from_worktree means the pilot record on disk is INCOMPLETE: those artifacts exist in git history but not in the working tree, so any count taken from the filesystem alone is a survivorship-filtered subset. on_disk_but_untracked artifacts are simply not committed yet. on_disk_but_gitignored artifacts are excluded from git by rule (bulky media), so no copy exists in history and the sha256 recorded here is their only integrity record -- back them up outside git.
